Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we…
Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

people.name: Bethsaida
people.line: Town where Jesus performed miracles, home of several disciples

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Philip
people.line: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus

translations.web: These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
translations.bsb: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and requested of him, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
translations.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
translations.asv: these therefore came to Philip, who was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
